data.name: GLP_1 RA stable dose requirement
data.text: Participants taking GLP_1 RAs, GLP_1/GIP RAs, GLP_1/Gcg RAs, GLP_1/GIP/Gcg RAs, or similar medications for approved indications will be permitted to enroll provided they are on a stable dose at the time of screening (no anticipated dose escalations).

data.name: Renal function exclusion
data.text: Have an eGFR <90 mL/min/1.73 m2 determined by the central laboratory during screening (Visit 1).

data.name: Hepatic disease or impairment exclusion
data.text: Have a hepatic disease or hepatic impairment, defined as any of the following: cirrhosis, primary biliary cholangitis, viral hepatitis, autoimmune hepatitis, or signs or symptoms of any other liver disease (exception: metabolic dysfunction_associated steatotic liver disease [MASLD]); any degree of hepatic impairment as defined by the Child_Pugh classification (Child_Pugh A, B, or C), regardless of etiology.

data.name: Osteoporosis or vitamin D deficiency exclusion
data.text: Have a history of osteoporosis, osteomalacia, or presence of untreated severe vitamin D deficiency (serum 25_hydroxy_vitamin D ≤5 ng/mL).

data.name: Fracture or bone surgery history exclusion
data.text: Have a history of fracture, bone surgery (for example, hardware placement, join replacement, bone grafting, or amputation), or clinically significant bone trauma within 8 weeks of screening.

data.name: Addison disease exclusion
data.text: Have a history of Addison disease.

data.name: Paget's disease of the bone exclusion
data.text: Have a history of Paget's disease of the bone.

data.name: Other bone disease affecting bone metabolism exclusion
data.text: Have a history of any other bone disease that effects bone metabolism (for example, osteopetrosis or osteogenesis imperfecta).

data.name: Recent major cardiovascular event exclusion
data.text: Have had within the past 180 days before screening: acute myocardial infarction; cerebrovascular accident (stroke); hospitalization for unstable angina; hospitalization due to congestive heart failure; or coronary revascularization.

data.name: Chronic neutropenia exclusion
data.text: Have a history of chronic neutropenia.

data.name: CYP3A4 inhibitors or inducers exclusion
data.text: Have been treated with moderate or strong CYP3A4 inhibitors or inducers within 14 days or 5 half_lives (whichever is longer) prior to randomization, or plan to receive treatment with these CYP3A4 modulators during the study. See Section 10.14 for a list of moderate and strong CYP3A4 inhibitors and inducers.

data.name: CYP3A4 narrow therapeutic index substrates exclusion
data.text: Have been treated with CYP3A4 substrates with a narrow therapeutic index within 14 days or 5 half_lives (whichever is longer) prior to randomization, or plan to receive treatment with these CYP3A4 modulators during the study. See Section 10.14 for a list of CYP3A4 substrates with a narrow therapeutic index.

data.name: Bone active treatments exclusion
data.text: Have received any of the following bone active treatments within the time frames specified below, or plan to receive them during the study: oral bisphosphonate use (>3 months cumulative treatment in the past 2 years, OR >1 month in the past year, OR any use during the 3 months prior to screening); administration of intravenous zoledronic acid within the last 5 years; administration of intravenous bisphosphonate (excluding zoledronic acid), fluoride, or strontium within the past 2 years; parathyroid hormone (PTH), or PTH derivative (teriparatide, abaloparatide) in the past year; or treatment with denosumab in the past year.

data.text: Following screening (up to 42 days before randomization) including endoscopy with biopsy performed within 21 days before randomization, eligible participants are registered with IWRS and randomized/assigned to an ISA and to study intervention at Visit 2 (Week 0).

data.name: Study Period 1 to Study Period 2 Transition

data.name: Temporary Discontinuation (Interruption) of LY4395089 for Suspected Fracture
